limitations: The evidence does not establish whether finite-difference gradient checks pass, so autodiff correctness cannot be confirmed.
Residual patterns suggest model/experimental mismatch but do not distinguish between input timing errors, initial condition misestimation, or structural model flaws.
The flat loss trace (0.25001 → 0.24954) over 5 iterations provides no evidence of convergence or global optimality, only local improvement.
Weak modes and negative curvature do not prove individual parameter non-identifiability; they indicate correlated parameter sensitivity.
